content:
Dana Ruiz: Heads-up, SunriseClinic (SUN-77) reported ACH setup failing for invoice INV-4812. Customer sees 'validation_failed' in their portal. Invoice due EOD. Any quick path?
Oscar Nguyen: Do we have the gateway error code? If it's account type mismatch we usually need a voided check. If they need access immediately, wire is fastest but needs approvals for >$5k.
PaymentsBot: ALERT: Payment attempt failed for INV-4812. Error: bank_account_validation_failed. Suggested next step: request voided check or manual wire. Ticket PAY-7612 created.
Dana Ruiz: Customer says bank is "CommunityTrust Bank" routing 222000111 and says it's a business account. Invoice amount $9,350. They can9t upload docs until tomorrow.
Marta Alvarez: I can approve a one-off same-day wire for invoices up to $10k with a signed payment waiver (email ok). Nora, quick ack?
Nora Li: I approve wire for $9,350 if waiver is on file and customer accepts $35 processing fee. Finance will clear when funds and remittance received.
Oscar Nguyen: Draft wire instructions being sent to customer now. Payload: ```
Wire USD 9,350.00
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Account: 987654321
Routing: 222000111
Bank: CommunityTrust Bank
Ref: INV-4812 / SUN-77
```
Dana Ruiz: Sent to customer with waiver template. Customer replied "agree" and provided a screenshot of transfer initiation94 waiting for confirmation.
PaymentsBot: NOTE: Marking invoice INV-4812 as pending manual settlement. Subtask PAY-7612-WIRE created.
Marta Alvarez: Once we receive wire confirmation, please upload receipt to PAY-7612 and cc billing@redwood.ai. Finance will reconcile and close the invoice.
Oscar Nguyen: Will update when funds land. Marking thread to resolve on payment confirmation. :white_check_mark:
